style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

Latvia lacks enough manpower to fully equip its divisions in 1936.
The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.

Latvia starts off with little Manpower but just enough to make 10 Units. Latvia has the Generic Focus Tree, so for your focuses, select Political Effort and continue down. For Research, you can Research the Normal. Next, you want to go either Fascist or Communist and once you're done, Start Justifing a Wargoal on ⟦0⟧ and then proceed to take them over. Once you finish conquering the Baltics, Justify a wargoal and attack ⟦1⟧. At the Peace Conference, you can either Annex all of ⟦2⟧ or puppet them. As well as Sataliting ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧. Then you can proceed to go after ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧. Once you're done with that, you can go attack ⟦7⟧ (as long as they don't join the Axis or get guaranteed by the Allies.) ⟦8⟧, ⟦9⟧, ⟦10⟧, ⟦11⟧, ⟦12⟧, ⟦13⟧, ⟦14⟧, ⟦15⟧, ⟦16⟧, Etc. Once you're done conquering Eastern Europe, you can go ahead and attack the ⟦17⟧ and take them over. You can then proceed to do a World Conquest after. Latvia also has the option to unite The Baltics. So you can also do that as well.
